description: This file defines a utility module for aggregating agent usage and cost data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It contains functions for parsing currency strings, constructing aggregation pipelines, and merging results to produce summary statistics per agent.

methods.name: toNumberSafe(value)
methods.description: Safely parses strings representing currency or large numbers to a numeric value, handling special characters like '$' and ','.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost( db, { tenant_id, project_id, from, to, limit = 50, offset = 0, } = {} )
methods.description: Main function that aggregates agent costs and usage from specified MongoDB collections based on provided filters, and returns a summarized list of agents with their total cost, total usage, session count, and source breakdown.
